data.name: Combat Trick / Exhausting Critical
data.description: When you threaten a critical hit against an exhausted target and choose to use Exhausting Critical, you can spend up to 5 stamina points. If you do, you gain a +2 bonus on the confirmation roll for each stamina point you spent.
